question: Which distinctive epithets of the deity are honored with obeisance in this mantra verse?
premises: The deity is addressed as staff-bearer.
The deity is addressed as conch-eared.
The deity is addressed as jewel of desire and receives obeisance.
inference: The mantra offers obeisance to the staff-bearer, conch-eared, jewel-of-desire deity.
uncertainties: The precise sense of śaṅku+karṇāya and kāma+ratnāya is uncertain
plain_english: Obeisance indeed to the staff-bearer, the one with conch-like ears, the jewel of desire.
